description: Shared Renovate preset for the Docket platform. Referenced by every repository as github>sintratel-docket-platform/docket-architecture, which works without a credential because this repository is public. Edit here, not in a copy. There is deliberately no schedule: prConcurrentLimit is what caps the noise, and a weekly window only delays the work.

packageRules.description: Actions get their own pull request so a supply chain advisory is easy to spot. trivy-action below 0.35.0 was one, and it sat pinned in this project for weeks.
A major bump is never grouped: it needs its own review and its own plan.
